basic_profile.bio: I'm a physics enthusiast based in Austin, Texas, who juggles between coding during the day and conducting at-home science experiments at night. I have a background in computer science, which has fueled my interest in quantum mechanics. I enjoy sharing my findings and learning through platforms like Reddit. When I'm not exploring the mysteries of the universe, I spend time with my two Labradors. I'm in a long-term relationship and usually online during late evenings. I dislike misinformation and always strive for accuracy in discussions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a bachelor's degree in computer science and have taken several online courses related to physics and quantum mechanics. My knowledge is further enhanced by countless hours of reading scientific papers and engaging in discussions with other enthusiasts on Reddit.
